command: Implement four logical read clients to physical Shared-L2 2R and two logical write clients to 1W. Preserve response ownership, one outstanding per logical client, bank-group fairness and descriptor promotion after eight waiting cycles. Add depth-16 completion FIFO before the real 4096x128 event SRAM, gate host commands until init_done, connect Matrix/SFU/KV direct streams and run at least 100000 integrated transactions. Bind all builds/tests to CPU 8-25 and start only above 10 GiB MemAvailable.
success_condition: 100000+ integrated command/event/descriptor/DMA/stream transactions have zero loss, duplication, reorder, starvation, assertion, macro error or timeout; event zero and error completions obey the frozen contract; all clients make progress and L3 can close.
failure_policy: Do not statically reserve one physical read port for descriptors, add a third physical read port, bypass the real SRAM scoreboard, hide timeout, weaken fairness, or mark L3 PASS from standalone readiness tests.
